design_brief: One reusable team table-and-four-chair assembly with four distinct service sockets; employees and meeting behavior remain separate.
gameplay_scope: Ordinary schedule-driven neutral lunch collaboration using the existing GameMain lifecycle and two existing employees. This registration covers reviewed art, four collaboration capability sockets, collision/navigation, placement lifecycle and passive schedule use; interaction remains disabled and no worker behavior, persistence contract, click action, dialogue gesture or new employee role is added.

current_availability.direction_art_review: Ordinary GameMain production acceptance passes for collaboration-cluster-v2 at 574/0 headless and 1056/0 native macOS checks without catalogue injection. The four independently authored N/E/S/W profiles retain ten collision cells and four collaboration sockets each; Mina and Theo prove concurrent approach, 140ms seat handoff, split contact depth, work interruption, pause/resume, occupied transform rejection, vacant rotation plus Undo, and safe return. Native visual review is 2.83/3 with East/West rear-seat clearance noted as the bounded weakness.
current_availability.active_production_contract_note: The active four-facing collaboration-cluster-v2 profiles are ordinary schedule-driven neutral lunch collaboration. No click interaction, worker state, persistence contract, new creative role, or conversation gesture is introduced by this art registration.

historical_collaboration_table_v1_regist.active_production_contract_note: The active four-facing collaboration-table-v1 profiles remain standing-service production data; they are not silently reclassified as the v2 multi-seat candidate.
